definitions.title: Invalid configuration
definitions.explanation: A bounded configuration value is invalid.

definitions.title: Unsupported ABI
definitions.explanation: The installed language package and native runtime do not share an ABI.

definitions.title: Unsupported semantic subject
definitions.explanation: The installed artifacts do not implement the same Auths meaning.

definitions.title: Malformed bounded input
definitions.explanation: The supplied bounded value could not be parsed.

definitions.title: Native runtime unavailable
definitions.explanation: The packaged Auths runtime could not be initialized.

definitions.title: Invalid execution reference
definitions.explanation: The execution reference is malformed, unauthenticated, or bound to different state.

definitions.title: Runtime state conflict
definitions.explanation: A concurrent operation changed the exact workflow state.

definitions.title: Runtime unavailable
definitions.explanation: The durable runtime could not complete an operation before provider entry.

definitions.title: Workflow cancelled
definitions.explanation: The workflow was cancelled with definite non-effect evidence.

definitions.title: Provider outcome unknown
definitions.explanation: The exact effect may have occurred and must be observed before retry.

definitions.title: Observation pending
definitions.explanation: The provider has not exposed conclusive evidence for the exact effect.

definitions.title: Observation inconclusive
definitions.explanation: Available evidence cannot prove effect or non-effect for the exact request.

definitions.title: Workflow already terminal
definitions.explanation: The workflow has already reached an immutable terminal state.

definitions.title: Internal invariant failure
definitions.explanation: Auths rejected an impossible internal state before an effect.

definitions.title: core.terminal-receipt-integrity-failed
definitions.explanation: The registered Auths contract rejected or classified this bounded operation.

definitions.title: Authorization denied
definitions.explanation: Available facts prove the supplied proof does not authorize the exact action.

definitions.title: Authorization indeterminate
definitions.explanation: A required authorization fact was unavailable, so no decision was reached before any effect.

definitions.title: Unauthenticated principal
definitions.explanation: The request asserts a principal the runtime cannot authenticate, so no authority is issued.

definitions.title: Local Auths agent unavailable
definitions.explanation: The SDK could not establish an authenticated local-agent session.

definitions.title: Profile unavailable
definitions.explanation: The local agent did not advertise the required profile and version.

definitions.title: Profile contract mismatch
definitions.explanation: The generated client and runtime do not share the same profile contract digest.

definitions.title: Provider connection contract mismatch
definitions.explanation: The profile runtime and selected provider connection do not share the required immutable connection contract.

definitions.title: Provider credential unavailable before entry
definitions.explanation: The bound provider credential could not be leased and durable state proves that the provider was not entered.

definitions.title: Provider connection unavailable
definitions.explanation: No active provider connection matching the requested or default alias is authorized for this workload and profile.

definitions.title: Operation admission exhausted
definitions.explanation: The bounded operation capacity was exhausted before provider entry.

definitions.title: Idempotency commitment conflict
definitions.explanation: The key names an existing operation with a different commitment; recover that operation.

definitions.title: Operation outcome unknown
definitions.explanation: The provider may have applied the exact operation; recover it instead of retrying.

definitions.title: Operation recovery unavailable
definitions.explanation: Recovery could not establish the effect and the original operation remains possible.

definitions.title: Operation timed out before provider entry
definitions.explanation: The bounded deadline expired and durable state proves that the provider was not entered.

definitions.title: OpenTofu plan preflight denied
definitions.explanation: The OpenTofu plan preflight failed its exact profile evaluation or protected-planner checks.

definitions.title: OpenTofu plan preflight outcome unknown
definitions.explanation: Recovery must establish whether the OpenTofu prepared-plan record and artifact became ready.

definitions.title: OpenTofu saved plan denied
definitions.explanation: The saved plan failed its exact OpenTofu profile evaluation.

definitions.title: OpenTofu apply outcome unknown
definitions.explanation: The OpenTofu apply must be reconciled before another execution.

definitions.title: PostgreSQL update preflight denied
definitions.explanation: The PostgreSQL update preflight failed its exact profile evaluation or protected discovery checks.

definitions.title: PostgreSQL update preflight outcome unknown
definitions.explanation: Recovery must establish whether the PostgreSQL prepared-update record became ready.

definitions.title: PostgreSQL update denied
definitions.explanation: The bounded PostgreSQL update failed its exact profile evaluation.

definitions.title: PostgreSQL update outcome unknown
definitions.explanation: The PostgreSQL transaction outcome must be reconciled before another execution.

definitions.title: Stripe refund denied
definitions.explanation: The exact Stripe refund was not authorized by the bounded profile.

definitions.title: Stripe refund outcome unknown
definitions.explanation: The Stripe refund outcome requires recovery before another execution.

definitions.title: Invalid MCP handler output
definitions.explanation: The invoked handler returned an invalid or oversized bounded result.

definitions.title: MCP handler failed
definitions.explanation: The invoked handler failed without conclusive no-effect evidence.

definitions.title: MCP handler timed out
definitions.explanation: The invoked handler did not produce conclusive effect evidence before its deadline.

definitions.title: MCP execution cancelled
definitions.explanation: Execution was cancelled before the handler was entered.

definitions.title: MCP reservation conflict
definitions.explanation: A different committed request already owns the execution record.

definitions.title: MCP replay blocked
definitions.explanation: The committed MCP execution has already reached a terminal state.

definitions.title: MCP receipt persistence failed
definitions.explanation: The effect was observed but its execution receipt was not durably persisted.

definitions.title: MCP reconciliation pending
definitions.explanation: The profile still lacks conclusive effect evidence.

definitions.title: Plan member interrupted
definitions.explanation: The current ordered member may have applied and later members remain blocked.

definitions.title: Plan member blocked
definitions.explanation: The current ordered member failed before provider entry.

definitions.title: Plan reference invalid
definitions.explanation: The supplied reference is not bound to this ordered plan execution.

definitions.title: Plan reconciliation pending
definitions.explanation: The current member remains outcome-unknown and later members remain blocked.

definitions.title: Plan action substituted
definitions.explanation: The current ordered member does not match the approved plan commitment.

definitions.title: Custody request denied
definitions.explanation: The configured custody provider denied the exact signing request.

definitions.title: Custody request cancelled
definitions.explanation: The exact signing request was cancelled before Auths accepted a signature.

definitions.title: Custody provider throttled
definitions.explanation: The custody provider refused the request under its current rate policy.

definitions.title: Custody provider unavailable
definitions.explanation: The custody provider could not conclusively service the exact signing request.

definitions.title: Custody key revoked
definitions.explanation: The configured key version is permanently barred from new signing.

definitions.title: Custody key disabled
definitions.explanation: The configured key version is not permitted to create new signatures.

definitions.title: Custody outcome unknown
definitions.explanation: The provider did not prove whether it produced a signature for the exact request.

definitions.title: Invalid custody response
definitions.explanation: The provider response could not be parsed as a bounded signing response.

definitions.title: Signing request mismatch
definitions.explanation: The provider response names a different signing request.

definitions.title: Signing principal mismatch
definitions.explanation: The provider response names a different signing principal.

definitions.title: Signing descriptor mismatch
definitions.explanation: The response signature method or suite differs from the frozen descriptor.

definitions.title: Signing key version mismatch
definitions.explanation: The provider response names a different key version.

definitions.title: Signing transaction mismatch
definitions.explanation: The provider response is bound to a different Auths transaction.

definitions.title: Malformed provider signature
definitions.explanation: The returned signature is not a bounded encoding accepted by its suite.

definitions.title: Non-canonical provider signature
definitions.explanation: The returned signature has a different canonical representation.

definitions.title: Provider signature invalid
definitions.explanation: The returned signature does not verify over the exact Auths preimage.

definitions.title: Custody evidence mismatch
definitions.explanation: The returned evidence does not match the frozen custody descriptor.

definitions.title: Custody lifecycle blocks signing
definitions.explanation: The exact key lifecycle state does not permit new signatures.
